questions.question: You need to distinguish “saponification of fats” from several related chapter concepts. Which description uniquely identifies it?

options.label: A
options.text: A 30-carbon triterpene precursor that undergoes stereospecific enzymatic epoxide cyclization to generate lanosterol and cholesterol.

options.label: B
options.text: A lipid formed by the esterification of glycerol with three fatty acid molecules, serving as primary biological energy storage.

options.label: C
options.text: A diverse hydrocarbon lipid constructed from recurring five-carbon isoprene (2-methyl-1,3-butadiene) building blocks.

options.label: D
options.text: The base-catalyzed hydrolysis of triglycerides with sodium hydroxide, yielding glycerol and fatty acid carboxylate salts (soap).

questions.correct_answer: The base-catalyzed hydrolysis of triglycerides with sodium hydroxide, yielding glycerol and fatty acid carboxylate salts (soap).
